rv.q: The great virtue of this production is that it offers variations on Stevenson’s original without vandalising it.
Fantastic in parts, then, but finally a bit yo-ho-hum.
I suspect this new version won’t quite hit the spot for anybody.
Watching Polly Findlay’s dull production I kept thinking that Robert Louis Stevenson’s adventure story can’t be as bad as this.

cn.t: An ambitious adaptation with imaginative gender-bent casting lacks the buccaneering vitality needed. Critics praise lovely design details and energy but find the production falls short of capturing the novel's full excitement.
